description: Turn numbers into a clean chart PNG: bar, horizontal_bar, stacked_bar, line, area, pie or donut. Returns the image, a link that works for a year (for emails, docs, Slack or markdown) and one-sentence alt text describing the data. Axes, number formatting, colors and labels are handled; pass the data and a title. Costs 1 credit.

currency.description: ISO code like USD or EUR, with format currency.

highlight.description: A label to emphasize; the other bars or slices go gray.

labels.description: One label per value: months, categories or slice names.

series.description: Several series share the labels. null leaves a gap in a line.

show_values.description: Force value labels on or off. By default they appear where they fit.

title.description: What the chart shows, like 'Monthly revenue'.

type.description: bar for comparing categories, line or area for change over time, stacked_bar for parts of a total over categories, pie or donut for shares of one total (6 slices max; the rest fold into Other), horizontal_bar for long category names.

values.description: For a single series. Use series instead for several.

name: render_chart
title: Make a chart image
